text: User reaffirms first-level uncertainty/error-model provenance as a prerequisite for SE-aware voxelwise group analysis. Fresh source review: native TContrastResult retains contrast SE and ordinary df, but FirstLevel.groupData retains effects/SE-squared only; full fit carries engine, preparation and available AR/robust diagnostics. In the application, ParticipantResponses.standardError/coefficientCovariance remain accessible after native inverse-covariance run pooling, while the dense participant inspector/reopen artifact is effects-only. Preserve contrast-specific variance, nominal versus estimated/effective df, error/whitening estimator and scope, run/censor boundaries, covariance propagation and known/estimated/unknown uncertainty distinctions. A field saying AR was fitted is provenance, not SE calibration. Existing calibration work must evaluate bias, empirical/reported variance, interval coverage, null rates and effect-variance dependence through first-level and pooling. Do not infer an effective df from the mere presence of an SE array. No native source edits in this review.
